reportedExperience.value: AI player report, not evidence of human enjoyment. Won all three stages in six commitments (actions 0–5), without failed actions or previews. Positive: explicit consequences, no arbitrary recipe guessing, inexhaustible concepts, and a real payoff for transforming a prior construction. Negative: all three public goals were readily recognizable Boolean patterns; after each recognition, most commitments were execution. I encountered construction and a small expression optimization, but no strategic tension, competing consequences, or sustained uncertainty. Mildly satisfying as a short logic exercise; not yet a compelling universe-creation game.

value.what: I would try one more level where existing composite conditions can be reused in a less immediately obvious way. More case tables differing by one simple pair would probably become routine.

value.decision: Intersect the entire stage-one result with A.
value.alternative: Make A AND C AND D, then union it with A AND B.
value.reason: The whole-condition refinement was simpler and preserved the required AB cases. This was an expression/construction choice rather than a consequential strategic tradeoff; both routes could succeed without penalty.

continuation.finding: No stopping/continuation protocol was recorded; instructed completion establishes no appetite.
continuation.limitation: This is behavior under an agent task, not voluntary human enjoyment. A stated wish, satisfying closure and actual elective construction are separate evidence.

liveQuestionAccount.limitation: A printed invitation is not an adopted question. A chosen authored possibility can still be sincerely valued. Origin and adoption above are reports or protocol events, not inferred intrinsic motivation.

experienceAcrossTime.provisionalInterpretation: Interest across time remains an open hypothesis; preserve specific appreciation and stopping reasons without inferring them from victory.

publicInitialObservation.goal: Create the required accepting condition for each stage. All goals are public; established conditions remain useful across stages.
rules: A case is a possible set of present supports A–D. Its required acceptance is a public goal constraint. This is a construction puzzle, not a claim about how real societies should judge evidence.
Every concept is a condition: the cases it accepts. ALL accepts exactly the intersection of two inputs; EITHER accepts exactly their union.
Establish a condition that accepts every required-accept case and rejects every required-reject case. All sixteen cases and every immediate combination consequence are inspectable.
Both inputs and every discovery remain. Equal resulting conditions reuse the same concept. There are no resource stocks, action quotas, gate limits or deadlines.
A–D and the possible worlds mean exactly the same thing at every stage. Only the required judgments change.
A matching condition automatically completes a stage and opens the next. Every earlier condition remains. A condition already established also satisfies a later stage without rebuilding.
No verbal decomposition or target formula is supplied. The complete public case constraints specify the goal; ALL/EITHER and all combination results remain explicit.

structuralReuse.interpretation: A structural use may be a normal prerequisite. Meaningful development requires its role and player experience, not this count alone.

reconstruction.visibility: Richer reconstructed functional state for review. It is not a claim about what the captured public observer disclosed or what a player understood.

publicInformation.interpretation: Captured observation references and access logs are available information, not proof it was read or understood. Reconstructed origin masks/history must not be attributed to an earlier compact observer.

F3.scope: Only the named consequence assertions and explicitly sampled legal alternatives are checked. Raw deltas, complete futures, subjective meaning and understanding are not scored.

F7.scope: Only a named, checked later functional role of an identified retained construction. Persistent IDs, repeated syntax, unlocks and appreciation alone earn no coverage.

limits: This adapter checks a few specified mechanisms; it does not infer arbitrary causes from co-occurring deltas.
Player notice, appreciation and closure remain source-linked reports, not mechanical findings.
No interesting-decision count, meaningfulness score, human enjoyment result or long-game claim follows.
Imprints currently has transition evidence only; no reviewed development or reuse claim is inferred.

Frontier checks only the named gate, scar, boundary and actual footprint discrepancy. A one-beat wait alternative is not an experienced event, permanent peace or complete counterpart-policy understanding.
